    parameter int DATA_W      = 32,   // 8 / 32 / 64
    parameter int LOG_DEPTH   = 3,   // 2 / 3 / 4  -> depth 4 / 8 / 16
    parameter int SYNC_STAGES = 2    // 2 / 3

    input  logic              wr_clk,
    input  logic              wr_rst_n,
    input  logic              wr_valid,
    output logic              wr_ready,
    input  logic [DATA_W-1:0] wr_data,

    input  logic              rd_clk,
    input  logic              rd_rst_n,
    output logic              rd_valid,
    input  logic              rd_ready,
    output logic [DATA_W-1:0] rd_data

    // Derived sizes

    localparam int PTR_W = LOG_DEPTH + 1;    // pointer width, incl. wrap bit

    // In binary that is "top bit differs, lower bits equal".  In Gray it is
    // "the two Gray words differ in exactly the top two bit positions",
    // i.e. wr_gray == rd_gray_sync ^ FULL_MASK.

    // State

    logic              wr_full_q;  // registered full flag      (wr_clk)
    logic [SYNC_STAGES-1:0][PTR_W-1:0] rd_sync_q; // rd Gray -> wr domain

    logic [PTR_W-1:0] rd_bin;     // binary read pointer       (rd_clk)
    logic              rd_empty_q; // registered empty flag    (rd_clk)
    logic [SYNC_STAGES-1:0][PTR_W-1:0] wr_sync_q; // wr Gray -> rd domain

    logic [PTR_W-1:0] wr_bin_next, wr_gray_next;
    logic [PTR_W-1:0] rd_bin_next, rd_gray_next;
    logic [PTR_W-1:0] rd_gray_sync_wr, wr_gray_sync_rd;

// Asynchronous FIFO carrying DATA_W-bit beats across two unrelated clock

// Gray-coded pointers:

//   * each pointer is converted to Gray code before crossing, so at most one

//   * full is detected in the write domain by comparing the next write

//     flop outputs and cannot depend combinationally on wr_valid / rd_ready;
//   * the payload itself is not synchronised: an entry is written in the
//     write domain and only read once the pointer covering it has safely
//     crossed, so it is stable by construction.

// at-rest capacity is exactly 2**LOG_DEPTH beats.

    parameter int LOG_DEPTH   = 3,   // 2 / 3 / 4  -> depth 4 / 8 / 16
